description: Mark a job done (owner or office). Refused with checklist_open while a job checklist, a checklist on a visit not yet done, or a sign-off checklist on a cancelled visit, has required items open or a sign-off missing; the owner, signed in on the hosted override page (/p/checklist/override), may pass override_reason to mark it done anyway (recorded and audited). Agents, keys and office staff cannot override.

override_reason.description: Owner in person only (hosted override page): why the job is done with checklist work left.

name: jobs_complete
